name: LLMLingua
title: LLMLingua: Compressing Prompts for Accelerated Inference of Large Language Models
authors: Huiqiang Jiang; Qianhui Wu; Chin-Yew Lin; Yuqing Yang; Lili Qiu
one_line: Small-LM perplexity coarse-to-fine prompt compression with budget controller and distribution alignment, up to 20x compression.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ACL Anthology page, and GitHub API; directly bears on Q6 payload compression.

name: LongLLMLingua
title: LongLLMLingua: Accelerating and Enhancing LLMs in Long Context Scenarios via Prompt Compression
authors: Huiqiang Jiang; Qianhui Wu; Xufang Luo; Dongsheng Li; Chin-Yew Lin; Yuqing Yang; Lili Qiu
one_line: Question-aware compression via contrastive perplexity plus document reordering; NQ +21.4% with 4x fewer tokens.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ACL Anthology citation, and Microsoft Research page; core Q6 evidence on query-aware payload assembly and ordering.

name: LLMLingua-2
title: LLMLingua-2: Data Distillation for Efficient and Faithful Task-Agnostic Prompt Compression
authors: Zhuoshi Pan; Qianhui Wu; Huiqiang Jiang; Menglin Xia; Xufang Luo; Jue Zhang et al.
one_line: Distils GPT-4 compression into a token-classification compressor (XLM-R/mBERT); task-agnostic, 3-6x faster.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page and Microsoft Research page; teacher-distilled dataset recipe transfers to MelodyScribe payload training.

name: RECOMP
title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Compression and Selective Augmentation
authors: Fangyuan Xu; Weijia Shi; Eunsol Choi
artefact_released: extractive+abstractive compressors on Hugging Face; code released
one_line: End-task-trained extractive and abstractive query-focused compressors with selective (possibly empty) augmentation.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ICLR proceedings page, repo README, and GitHub API; closest precedent for training a small composer against consumer end-task signal.

name: FILCO
title: Learning to Filter Context for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Zhiruo Wang; Jun Araki; Zhengbao Jiang; Md Rizwan Parvez; Graham Neubig
one_line: Sentence-level context filtering trained on StrInc/lexical/CXMI silver labels; +3 pts avg, 44-64% shorter prompts.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page and GitHub API; sentence-filtering recipe with utility-based silver labels maps to Proof-gated evidence selection.

name: Selective-Context
title: Compressing Context to Enhance Inference Efficiency of Large Language Models
authors: Yucheng Li; Bo Dong; Chenghua Lin; Frank Guerin
one_line: Self-information filtering of lexical units; 50% context cut at minor quality loss; thresholds are domain-dependent.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, repo README, and GitHub API; baseline method superseded by question-aware successors, hence relevance 2.

name: Gist
title: Learning to Compress Prompts with Gist Tokens
authors: Jesse Mu; Xiang Lisa Li; Noah Goodman
one_line: Attention-mask trick that learns gist-token compression during instruction tuning at no extra cost; up to 26x.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, NeurIPS proceedings page, repo README, and GitHub API; meta-distillation framing is the closest analogue of the [EMB]-marker joint objective.

name: AutoCompressors
title: Adapting Language Models to Compress Contexts
authors: Alexis Chevalier; Alexander Wettig; Anirudh Ajith; Danqi Chen
one_line: Unsupervised summary-vector compression with summary accumulation; OPT/LLaMA-2 to 30k tokens on one 80GB GPU.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ACL Anthology page, repo README, and GitHub API; proves soft compression trainable at small scale on single GPU.

name: ICAE
title: In-context Autoencoder for Context Compression in a Large Language Model
authors: Tao Ge; Jing Hu; Lei Wang; Xun Wang; Si-Qing Chen; Furu Wei
artefact_released: PWC 240k dataset and LoRA-encoder model released
one_line: LoRA encoder (~1% params) compresses context to memory slots for a frozen LLM; AE+LM pretrain then instruction fine-tune; 4x.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ICLR proceedings page, repo README, and GitHub API; LoRA-encoder plus frozen-consumer split mirrors MelodyScribe's adapter plan.

name: xRAG
title: xRAG: Extreme Context Compression for Retrieval-augmented Generation with One Token
authors: Xin Cheng; Xun Wang; Xingxing Zhang; Tao Ge; Si-Qing Chen; Furu Wei; Huishuai Zhang; Dongyan Zhao
license: Two-layer projector maps frozen dense-retrieval embedding to one token for a frozen LLM; +10% avg, 3.53x fewer FLOPs.
relevance_0_3: Verified at arXiv abs page and NeurIPS proceedings page; direct precedent for retrieval embedding as consumable token, but single-document only and projector is consumer-specific.

name: Lost-in-the-Middle
title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
authors: Nelson F. Liu; Kevin Lin; John Hewitt; Ashwin Paranjape; Michele Bevilacqua; Fabio Petroni; Percy Liang
one_line: U-shaped position bias; reader QA saturates by ~20 docs; recommends reranking and truncation.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page and TACL/ACL Anthology pages; repo URL from paper text, star/push/license not verified via API (rate-limited) so recorded as unknown.

name: Voyager
title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
authors: Guanzhi Wang; Yuqi Xie; Yunfan Jiang; Ajay Mandlekar; Chaowei Xiao; Yuke Zhu; Linxi Fan; Anima Anandkumar
one_line: Ever-growing library of model-written code skills indexed by description embedding with iterative self-verification.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, project page, and GitHub API; precedent for Folio-style model-written reusable procedures, though unvalidated for retrieval payloads.

name: MemGPT
title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
authors: Charles Packer; Sarah Wooders; Kevin Lin; Vivian Fang; Shishir G. Patil; Ion Stoica; Joseph E. Gonzalez
one_line: OS-style virtual context management: hierarchical memory with function-call paging and heartbeat chaining.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page and GitHub API (successor repo); architectural precedent for self-directed payload management, not a trained composer.

name: RAPTOR
title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
authors: Parth Sarthi; Salman Abdullah; Aditi Tuli; Shubh Khanna; Anna Goldie; Christopher D. Manning
one_line: Recursive embed-cluster-summarize tree; collapsed-tree retrieval mixes abstraction levels; QuALITY +20pp with GPT-4.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ICLR proceedings page, and GitHub API; multi-granularity payload assembly directly applicable to sectioned-document payloads.

name: Self-RAG
title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
authors: Akari Asai; Zeqiu Wu; Yizhong Wang; Avirup Sil; Hannaneh Hajishirzi
one_line: Reflection tokens for on-demand retrieval and self-critique distilled offline from GPT-4; 7B beats ChatGPT on ODQA/reasoning.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ICLR proceedings page, project page, repo, and GitHub API; validator-signal training and token-level control are the closest match to Proof-gated op emission.

name: QMSum
title: QMSum: A New Benchmark for Query-based Multi-domain Meeting Summarization
authors: Ming Zhong; Da Yin; Tao Yu; Ahmad Zaidi; Mutethia Mutuma; Rahul Jha; Ahmed Hassan Awadallah; Asli Celikyilmaz; Yang Liu; Xipeng Qiu; Dragomir Radev
one_line: 1808 query-summary pairs over 232 meetings in 3 domains; locate-then-summarize baseline; cross-domain generalization fails.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, repo README, and GitHub API; query-focused summarization eval precedent, but meeting domain and no consumer-quality linkage.

name: GSM-IC
title: Large Language Models Can Be Easily Distracted by Irrelevant Context
authors: Freda Shi; Xinyun Chen; Kanishka Misra; Nathan Scales; David Dohan; Ed H. Chi; Nathanael Scharli; Denny Zhou
license: Measures consumer accuracy collapse under irrelevant context; self-consistency and distractor-aware exemplars mitigate.
relevance_0_3: Verified at arXiv abs page and PMLR proceedings page; consumer-quality-vs-payload-noise evidence, though on math reasoning rather than retrieval payloads.

name: Robust-RALM
title: Making Retrieval-Augmented Language Models Robust to Irrelevant Context
authors: Ori Yoran; Tomer Wolfson; Ori Ram; Jonathan Berant
license: Characterizes when retrieval hurts QA; NLI back-off baseline; 1000-example mixed relevant/irrelevant fine-tune yields robustness.
relevance_0_3: Verified at arXiv abs and html pages; authors per arXiv listing; mixed-context fine-tuning recipe transfers directly to MelodyScribe dataset design. Repo not confirmed from fetched pages.

name: ARES
title: ARES: An Automated Evaluation Framework for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
authors: Jon Saad-Falcon; Omar Khattab; Christopher Potts; Matei Zaharia
one_line: Synthetic-QA fine-tuned judges for context relevance, answer faithfulness, answer relevance with PPI confidence intervals; beats RAGAS.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ACL Anthology page, and fetched repo page (stars/license/push from repo page; GitHub API rate-limited at check time).

name: Generative-Agents
title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
authors: Joon Sung Park; Joseph C. O'Brien; Carrie J. Cai; Meredith Ringel Morris; Percy Liang; Michael S. Bernstein
one_line: Memory stream with relevance-recency-importance retrieval plus reflection synthesis; ablations and failure taxonomy (retrieval failure, confabulation).
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ACM page, and GitHub API; retrieval-scoring and reflection precedent for Folios; no consumer-QA linkage.

name: RankGPT
title: Is ChatGPT Good at Search? Investigating Large Language Models as Re-Ranking Agents
authors: Weiwei Sun; Lingyong Yan; Xinyu Ma; Shuaiqiang Wang; Pengjie Ren; Zhumin Chen; Dawei Yin; Zhaochun Ren
one_line: Instructional permutation generation with sliding window; GPT-4 beats supervised rankers; distilled 435M student beats 3B monoT5 on BEIR.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, ACL Anthology page, repo README, and GitHub API; ordering payload by relevance and distilling the ranker into a small model maps directly onto MelodyScribe.

name: Reflexion
title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
authors: Noah Shinn; Federico Cassano; Edward Berman; Ashwin Gopinath; Karthik Narasimhan; Shunyu Yao
one_line: Actor/Evaluator/Self-Reflection loop storing verbal feedback in a small episodic buffer; 91% HumanEval.
reason: Verified at arXiv abs page, repo README, and GitHub API; verbal-feedback loop precedent for Proof-feedback-to-Folio iteration, at prompting level only.
